value.capability_required: satellite imaging and analysis tools to monitor and predict movement patterns
value.rationale: By using satellite imaging to monitor the Stryker Brigade Combat Team's movements, an adversary can predict deployment schedules and plan accordingly to exploit any operational weaknesses.

value.capability_required: cyber capabilities to disrupt logistical software systems
value.rationale: Targeting the logistical operations of the 593rd Expeditionary Sustainment Command can disrupt supply chains, which are critical for sustaining military operations, thereby exploiting the cascade exposure.

value.capability_required: jamming equipment to interfere with communication and coordination during artillery operations
value.rationale: By disrupting communications of the 17th Field Artillery Brigade, an adversary can hinder artillery operations, exploiting the compromised aircraft movement data to anticipate and counteract their actions.
